CustomField.description: Field indicate net total based on list price to be used for setup calculation
CustomField.formula: IF( NSP_Max_Quantity__c >= NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c, MAX(SBQQ__ListPrice__c* NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c,NSP_Final_Minimum_Fee__c) , IF( SBQQ__HasConsumptionSchedule__c , SBQQ__ListPrice__c* NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c , IF( AND( TEXT(SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c) = "Annual", ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__PricingMethod__c , "List"), SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c = 1) , SBQQ__ListPrice__c * NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c * 12 , SBQQ__NetTotal__c ) ) )
